# Structured knowledge base query tools

A suite of server-exposed tools provides structured access to the knowledge base for engineering workflows. These APIs support entity search, entity inspection, impact and test planning, context lookup, journey coverage analysis, dependency resolution, entity listing, recent change tracking, provenance inspection, coverage review, and overall knowledge base health statistics. Users interact with the server exclusively through these defined queries, ensuring consistent and reliable access to compiled knowledge.
